::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 21st 1894  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library  Add MSS 54921: 208-9
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)
I see that your [‘house’](organizations/other_111.qmd) appears in the list of subscribers to the [Surgical Aid Society](organizations/other_16.qmd). Do you think one or more letters could be spared to me? A little child was sent from the Society for protecting [Waifs and Strays](organizations/other_2.qmd) with a lame foot paralysed after measles- to be boarded at a cottage here. She is now in the [Orthopaedic hospital](organizations/other_9.qmd), but she requires a boot and irons, and the expense is heavy, so that we should be very thankful for any letters to the surgical aid society to help us with it

Yours truly
C M Yonge
